title: Bought ranch as skeptic intending to donate to Boy Scouts

tellings.quote: claims and I actually intended to to donate it to the Boy Scouts of America

plain: The current owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for reports of strange happenings, says he bought it in 2016 as a skeptic of all the stories told about it. He says he had actually planned to give the land to the Boy Scouts of America. He tells this about himself, which matters because it means he did not come to the ranch expecting to find anything unusual.
